evidence_summary: Systematic WNT-FZD binding/function mapping and targeted studies support WNT5B engagement of FZD1 and receptor-dependent noncanonical signaling.
limitations: Affinity and functional response depend on assay and cell context; some literature uses WNT5A/WNT5B family nomenclature.
search_notes: PubMed and Europe PMC exact and expanded searches covered WNT5B, WNT5A aliases, FZD1/Frizzled-1, mature/lipidated ligand, binding, activation, adhesion, structures, function, and species; family-only evidence was not used alone.

evidence_summary: Recent primary NSCLC work reports WNT5B-FZD3 co-immunoprecipitation and FZD3-dependent DVL3/PCP-JNK signaling.
limitations: The evidence is disease-model and cell-context specific and the article was located via authoritative publisher indexing rather than a stable PMID in the search output.
search_notes: PubMed and Europe PMC exact and expanded searches covered WNT5B, aliases, FZD3, processed ligand, binding, activation, adhesion, structures, function, and species; the disease-model limitation was retained.
